# swarm Provider

Manages Docker Swarm clusters. A `swarm_cluster` inits its cluster, or adopts one that runs already, and keeps its nodes as the configuration gives them. Each node gives its own Docker endpoint, so the provider takes no configuration and one configuration can manage several clusters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Each node of a swarm_cluster gives its own endpoint: the provider takes no configuration.
provider "swarm" {}
```
